description: A breathtaking outdoor Mediterranean wedding banquet table set at sunset on a clifftop terrace overlooking the sea. The sky blazes in deep amber and orange, reflected in the glassy turquoise water of an infinity pool that appears to merge with the ocean horizon. Rocky island silhouettes punctuate the golden horizon. The venue is framed by two arched pergola structures woven in natural pale wicker or rattan, draped with delicate string lights that twinkle along the curves. The long banquet table is covered in a pale silver-grey linen tablecloth and set with layered white dinner plates, crystal wine glasses, silverware, and folded linen napkins for a dozen guests. Beige banquet chairs with gold metal frames line both sides. An abundant floral table runner runs the length of the table in blush pink, ivory, and peachy roses with scattered greenery. Ivory pillar candles in low holders are interspersed throughout, their warm flames contributing soft glows to the romantic dusk atmosphere. Loose hanging arrangements of blush roses top the suspended installations above. Warm glowing pools of amber light cascade downward onto the table, intensifying the intimacy of the candlelit setting. Camera at slightly elevated standing height, off-center three-quarter composition angled from the left end of the table looking toward the sunset, wide lens. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
